verdict.rationale: The aihero.dev/skills page is a browsable catalog. It lists each skill with a one-line description (spec writing, ticket splitting, TDD build, diff review, bug diagnosis, triage and more) and a count of 25–27 skills, and invites users to 'pick the skills… install the ones you want' before installing. The set is also listed in Claude Code's official plugin marketplace, and a runtime probe confirmed you can selectively install a single named skill after choosing it. missing for 10: no evidence of search or filtering within the catalog, the catalog covers only this author's own set rather than a broader registry or leaderboard, and no independent corroboration of the marketplace listing's browse experience.
